detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #34 Browser Selection and File Verification The browser launcher should match the mode the system actually prepared. PH4NTXM's browser-mode stage begins with both browser directories masked, then exposes the browser selected for the session. Lone Wolf verifies the installed Tor Browser files against a manifest before publishing verification state. The live user's launcher is installed atomically after account and destination checks. In Lone Wolf, that setup also requires browser verification state. This connects mode selection, installed browser files, and the desktop entry the operator uses, while retaining trust in the installed manifest as part of the boot environment. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
